description: This file defines an IdleFrameProcessor class that monitors incoming frames within a pipeline, triggers callbacks on timeout or certain frame events, and manages associated asynchronous tasks.

classes.name: IdleFrameProcessor
classes.description: A processor that monitors frame activity and executes a callback if no frames are received within a specified timeout. It extends FrameProcessor and manages asynchronous idle timeout tasks.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, callback: Callable[["IdleFrameProcessor"], Awaitable[None]], timeout: float, types: Optional[List[type]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the IdleFrameProcessor with callback, timeout, optional frame types to monitor, and additional keyword arguments.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Handles incoming frames, resets idle timer on StartFrame, and triggers event when frames of interest are received.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources by cancelling any pending idle tasks.

methods.name: _create_idle_task(self)
methods.description: Creates and starts the asynchronous idle monitoring task and event.

methods.name: _idle_task_handler(self)
methods.description: Asynchronous loop that waits for the idle event with a timeout; on timeout, executes the callback.
